name: capstone-core-backend
description: Scripts for managing the capstone core backend services

scripts.n8n:export:workflows: docker exec n8n sh -c "rm -f /workflows/*.json" && docker exec n8n n8n export:workflow --backup --output=/workflows/
scripts.n8n:export:credentials: docker exec n8n sh -c "rm -f /workflows/credentials/*.json" && docker exec n8n n8n export:credentials --backup --output=/workflows/credentials/ --decrypted
scripts.n8n:export: npm run n8n:export:workflows && npm run n8n:export:credentials
scripts.n8n:import: npm run n8n:import:workflows && npm run n8n:import:credentials
